```yaml
name: Deploy OfficeIMO Website

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

concurrency:
  group: deploy-website
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout PSWriteOffice repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: EvotecIT/PSWriteOffice
          path: PSWriteOffice
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '7.x'

      - name: Build website
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          PSWriteOfficeRoot: ${{ github.workspace }}\PSWriteOffice
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID_OFFICEIMO }}
        run: |
          ./Website/build.ps1 -SkipBuildTool -CI -PSWriteOfficeRoot $env:PSWriteOfficeRoot

      - name: Upload website artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: Website/_site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v2

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v2
```
